findings.text: Only 1 of 3 passes could be measured (2 blocked). The figures come from a minority of passes and are indicative only.
During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 929 requests to 172 third-party domains (median of 1 passes).
Of 14.9 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 12.1 MB (81%) came from third-party domains, 2.6 MB of it from services classified as tracking (429 requests).

82 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsafeprotected.com (Integral Ad Science, advertising).
385 cookies were set by third-party domains (446 cookies in total).
A script served from dualping.com read image data from a canvas element. This API is also used for legitimate purposes and does not by itself indicate tracking.
